 William Reportedly ‘On Edge’ as He Gives Harry 1 ‘Off-Limits’ Condition Related to Meghan for Their 1st Official Meeting
 Can the brothers bury the hatchet once and for all? By Lizzie Lanuza Plus icon Lizzie Lanuza

 We’ve been following the drama surrounding Prince William and Prince Harry ‘s estranged relationship for a few years now. Before Harry moved to the UK, that drama was all long-distance—but now that they live in the same country again, it’s all escalated. Or, at least, the fact that they’re still not speaking has become even bigger news.
 RadarOnline reports that the feud has become even more distressing for William amid the new revelations about Princess Diana in Charles Spencer’s Swan Song: Diana, My Sister. Particularly because William believes Harry is on their uncle’s side in all of this.
 Related Stories William Reportedly ‘Waiting’ Until Charles’ Death to ‘Make’ 1 ‘Move’ That Would ‘Enrage’ the King if He Was Still Alive ‘Upset’ Meghan Reportedly ‘Devastated’ by ‘Biggest Snub’ from Eugenie 
 “William is particularly troubled by what he perceives as a growing alliance between Harry and their uncle,” an insider told the outlet. “William believes the relationship risks turning longstanding family disagreements into another public confrontation, particularly when the monarchy is already facing considerable scrutiny.”
 “Spencer’s memoir revisits the bitter disagreements surrounding Diana’s funeral, including whether her sons should walk behind their mother’s coffin, and Harry is said to have encouraged his uncle to write it. It is all pushing William to the edge.”
 In one excerpt from the novel, Spencer detailed a conversation he had with Charles after Diana’s tragic death on Aug. 31, 1997. “The phone rang constantly. Prince Charles caught me as I crossed the landing upstairs,” Spencer wrote. “Unlike my other callers, who were stunned, barely able to articulate their condolences and offers of help, he sounded giddily elated — like a lottery winner, I remember thinking at the time.”
 He also claimed that Charles said, “We’ll forget her soon enough.”
 A palace spokesperson immediately issued a statement about the book’s claims: “While we do not comment on books as a matter of principle, His Majesty is mindful that the pain of fraternal grief can cloud reason, affect judgment and color memory in ways others do not recognize, even many years after such a loss.”
 William’s anxious feelings come after Closer reported that Harry was “attempting to arrange a secret meeting” with William. However, royal insider Rob Shuter added that William has one condition related to Meghan Markle : she needs to keep his family’s name out of her mouth.
 “William is willing to speak to Harry, but he wants Catherine and his children kept out of Meghan’s mouth,” the source explained, even though Meghan hasn’t publicly made a comment about either in years. “No public comments, no private briefings, no dragging his wife or children into their grievances. They’re off-limits.”
 Allegedly, King Charles has urged Harry and William to make amends, but William has refused.
 Related: Harry & Meghan Officially Set ‘Important’ Meeting with Charles as Sources Finally Confirm if There’s Been ‘Communication’ with William 
 But if the two brothers are actually close to meeting, it has nothing to do with William wanting to reconcile—it’s reportedly because the feud is making him look bad. “They’re being laughed at,” the source revealed to Shuter. “This is the future King and his brother, not two schoolboys refusing to sit together at lunch. Somebody has to grow up.”
 The pressure is now on the man who will one day be king to see if he can indeed do that.
